Automated by `org-defaults.yml`. A fetched file changed on `main`, so the bootstrap pin no longer serves what `main` contains — a session **without `.github` attached** would install the older copy until this lands.

Generated by `node .claude/gen-bootstrap-pin.mjs $GITHUB_SHA`; the same code backs the `--check` gate, so the gate and the fix cannot disagree.

This PR is opened only when the pin is **wrong** — the digests do not describe it, or it serves different bytes than `main` does. A pin that merely trails `main` while serving byte-identical files is correct, so merging this will not cause another one.
